component.name: Desktop Subsystem for Android
component.summary: Runs Android apps in windows of their own on the desktop

description.p: Desktop Subsystem for Android™ (DSA) runs Android in a dedicated lightweight VM and shows each Android task as a desktop window, with the computer's sound, cameras, location, sensors, printers and folders lent to its apps.
Installing the package adds DSA's signed package repository, so new versions arrive with the system's other updates. Removing the package removes the repository again.
